implementation_prerequisites.description: Master explicit adoption of the paired child CLI carrier (-childoperatorconfig, -childoperatorconfigsha, -childoperatororigin, -childoperatorlaunchplan, -childoperatorconfigid, -childoperatorrole, -childoperatorcapability) or an equivalent operator bundle.
implementation_prerequisites.threat_model_rationale: Prevents invention of ad-hoc unadmitted CLI schemas. Binding is validated against SHA-256 digest and descriptor fields at bootstrap.

implementation_prerequisites.description: Confirmation of strict pairing invariant: Parent MUST be role 'SIMULATION', Paired Child MUST be role 'READ_ONLY'. Any attempt to pair identical roles (SIMULATION-SIMULATION) or invert roles must be fail-closed rejected.
implementation_prerequisites.threat_model_rationale: Prevents recursive simulation launches, privilege escalation, and self-validation loops.

implementation_prerequisites.description: Definition of an explicit allowlist for optional ValidatorArguments in the child config (e.g. allowing only '-batchmode', '-nographics', '-logFile <path>'). Blind concatenation or splitting without an allowlist is prohibited.
implementation_prerequisites.threat_model_rationale: Mitigates arbitrary argument injection into the native process invocation.

implementation_prerequisites.description: Enforcement of single-use task consumption: once HandleLaunchOperatorValidator successfully spawns the child process, the ValidatorTask must be marked as consumed or bound to the active process PID/StartTime, preventing replay.
implementation_prerequisites.threat_model_rationale: Maintains M05 task identity binding and prevents concurrent launch abuse under the same capability nonce.

implementation_prerequisites.description: Maintain existing unguessable capability nonce and SHA-256 digest architecture per ADR-006B / MD126. No external public-key infrastructure (PKI) or mutual certificate pinning is required for the local loopback child invocation.
implementation_prerequisites.threat_model_rationale: Adheres strictly to Master instructions and prevents scope inflation.
